intro.Postać/Walka: Combat helpers for the hero: attack speed, infinite ammo, free aim with an over-the-shoulder camera, and an aimbot / trigger bot that only work together with free aim.
intro.Postać/Ruch: Ways to move around the world: no-clip (fly through walls), glide (walk on the ground without physics), hero speed and sprint. No-clip and glide cannot be on at the same time.

atkspeed: animation speed only with a weapon drawn: swings, drawing a bow, reloading a crossbow, casting spells
infammo: arrows and bolts refill by themselves while a bow / crossbow is drawn
freeaim: bow, crossbow, spells: over-the-shoulder camera, the mouse aims up/down — the shot flies at the character under the crosshair (also up and down)
fahl: Highlight the target under the crosshair
aimbot: requires free aim; while the key is held it turns the hero to the target and puts the crosshair on it
aimstick: does not switch to another one while the target is alive and in range
trigbot: requires free aim; shoots / casts when an allowed target is under the crosshair
noclip: through walls; WASD, mouse turns, Space/Ctrl up/down, Shift x4; Esc turns it off
ncmouse: moving the mouse sideways turns the hero, up/down tilts the camera
ncignore: monsters and enemies do not notice you in no-clip
glide: walks on the ground without physics and animations; WASD, Shift x4; Esc turns it off
glcoll: trees, rocks, bridges, grates, fences — you walk onto them instead of passing through
glideslope: degrees; steep walls up to this angle are climbed (90 = climbs any wall vertically)
sprint: running overlay from the speed potion
